q0938: Meeting after the incident to discuss what to improve = lessons learned.
q0939: Realistic test data with the sensitive parts scrambled = obfuscation/masking.
q0940: Lost or stolen laptop → full disk encryption.
q0941: Is this attachment malicious? Detonate it in a sandbox and watch what it does.
q0942: Rehearse the playbook with a simulated scenario, then assess = tabletop exercise.
q0943: Automates vulnerability and configuration checking with machine-readable standards = SCAP.
q0944: One-time risk assessment = a one-off event (decommissioning, a merger, a single project). Recurring = ongoing.
q0945: Trusted site the victims already use starts delivering malware = watering hole.
q0946: Active connection to a malicious IP → contain first: isolate the host.
q0947: Can't patch (end of life) and can't retire (business-critical) → isolate/segment it.
q0948: Hacktivist motive = ideology (philosophical or political beliefs).
q0950: Security config (WAF rules) deployed automatically with the app = IaC.
q0951: Proprietary, rugged, runs for decades, little remote management = ICS/SCADA.
q0952: Hot = fastest/most expensive. Cold = cheapest/slowest. 'Quick AND low cost' = warm, the middle ground.
q0953: One standard, vetted configuration template for many devices = benchmarks (e.g., CIS).
q0954: Rewards or competition for good security behavior = gamification.
q0955: Vulnerabilities appear right after a GPO push = misconfiguration.
q0956: Logic bomb planted in in-house code = trusted insider (needs code access).
q0957: MDM on company-owned devices controls which apps run → blocks unsupported applications.
q0958: Ignoring privacy law obligations (right to be forgotten) → regulatory fines.
q0959: Employees taking data with legitimate access → UBA flags behavior that departs from their normal pattern.
q0960: Stop pivoting from dev to prod in the cloud → separate VPCs (real network separation).
q0961: Encryption = confidentiality. Hashing = integrity. Signatures = non-repudiation.
q0962: Recover data after a key is lost or corrupted = key escrow.
q0963: Compare a yearly license cost against yearly expected loss = ALE.
q0964: Make a device unreachable from the network = host isolation.
q0965: Details of a webmail login (source IP, account) = application logs.
q0966: Labeling data by value, sensitivity or regulation = classification.
q0967: Failed change overran the window → a backout plan limits the damage next time.
